name: Colette and Becca
source:
Eight years ago, Colette was an aspiring teen hero who saved a young girl from drowning. Now, Colette is a mercenary for various aspiring world dominators; the girl she saved, Becca, now an aspiring teen hero herself. The two are reunited by circumstance and, at Becca’s insistence, meet up over the course of the summer to find out a few important things: Who they were, who they are, where they’ve been, and where they’re going.

[From [url=https://caveat-lector.itch.io/colette-and-becca]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
八年前，Colette还是一名立志成为英雄的少女，曾救起一个溺水的小女孩。如今，Colette成了受雇于各路野心家、帮助他们谋求统治世界的佣兵；而她救下的Becca，也成了立志成为英雄的少女。机缘巧合之下，两人重逢。在Becca的坚持下，她们在这个夏天不断见面，试图弄清一些重要的事：曾经的她们是谁，如今的她们又是谁；她们走过了怎样的路，又将去向何方。

[来源：[url=https://caveat-lector.itch.io/colette-and-becca]Itch.io[/url]]
